picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 9, 1 segment(s), 48s
[00:06.30-00:11.10] PEASANT MOTHER (Frantic, Weeping): "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"
[00:11.20-00:13.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.
[00:11.40-00:13.30] JULIANA (Urgent, Compassionate): "Bring him here. Quickly."
[00:12.00-00:14.20] ACTION: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
[00:13.80-00:15.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
[00:15.20-00:17.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.
[00:15.50-00:19.80] JULIANA (Reassuring, Focused): "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"
[00:17.80-00:20.00] CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
[00:20.00-00:24.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.
[00:20.50-00:23.90] PEASANT MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious): "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."
[00:24.00-00:27.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
[00:27.20-00:28.80] ACTION: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
[00:28.80-00:31.00] CAMERA: Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.
[00:29.00-00:30.80] JULIANA (Muttering, Intent): "Feverfew... Not alone."
[00:31.00-00:34.00] CAMERA: Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.
[00:31.80-00:33.80] JULIANA (Determined): "Chamomile... and willow bark."
[00:34.00-00:36.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.
[00:34.90-00:35.80] ALEXANDER (Grave): "You're certain?"
[00:36.00-00:38.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.
[00:36.30-00:37.40] JULIANA (Resolute): "I have to be."
[00:38.00-00:39.80] ACTION: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
[00:38.20-00:39.80] JULIANA (Urgent): "Alexander, I need hot water."
[00:39.90-00:40.80] ALEXANDER (Prompt): "I'm on it."
[00:40.80-00:42.50] ACTION: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
[00:41.00-00:42.50] PEASANT MOTHER (Sobbing): "Please save him."
[00:42.20-00:43.50] ACTION: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
[00:43.00-00:46.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.
[00:43.80-00:45.60] JULIANA (Gentle, Steadfast): "He is not beyond saving."
[00:46.00-00:48.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
[00:47.00-00:48.20] ACTION: The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
[00:48.00-00:50.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
[00:50.50-00:52.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
[00:52.50-00:54.00] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.
[00:52.50-00:54.00] PEASANT MOTHER (Despairing): "Why isn't it working?"
[00:54.00-00:54.25] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

[00:58.80-01:01.80] PEASANT MOTHER (Overcome with Emotion): "His fever... it's breaking."

[01:04.00-01:05.60] CAMERA: Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.
[01:04.20-01:05.50] PEASANT MOTHER (Tearful, Grateful): "You saved him."
[01:05.60-01:08.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.
[01:05.80-01:08.20] JULIANA (Soft, Gracious): "The herbs did their work. Let him rest."
[01:08.00-01:10.50] ACTION: Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
[01:10.50-01:13.00] ACTION: The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.

[01:11.20-01:14.80] PEASANT MOTHER (Reverent, Vowing): "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
[01:14.50-01:15.50] ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
[01:14.80-01:17.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.
[01:15.10-01:17.50] ALEXANDER (Stern, Warning): "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
[01:17.50-01:19.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.
[01:17.60-01:19.40] JULIANA (Defiant, Principled): "A child's life matters more than gossip."
[01:19.50-01:21.70] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.
[01:19.60-01:21.60] ALEXANDER (Dark, Cautionary): "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
[01:21.70-01:23.80] CAMERA: Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.
[01:22.00-01:23.80] JULIANA (Committed, Unshakable): "Then we will face it together."

[01:24.00-01:26.50] ACTION: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
[01:26.50-01:28.00] CAMERA: Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.
[01:26.60-01:27.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Aloof, Without Looking Up): "What is it?"

[01:30.20-01:31.65] CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.
[01:30.60-01:31.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious): "What rumor?"
